name: revenge-toast-guard
description: Revenge plugin that stops the Discord toast container crash (Revenge Next and legacy)

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --outfile=dist/index.js --target=browser --format=esm --external '@revenge-mod/*' --external 'react' --external 'react-native' && node scripts/build-legacy.mjs && node scripts/build-package.mjs
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run build && bun run test
